name: Cave mouth
desc: A threshold - shelter behind, weather ahead, and the choice of which way to go.
tags: scenery, no humans, cave entrance, rock overhang, jagged stone arch, daylight outside, dark interior beyond, scree and boulders on cave floor, dripping water, ferns at the entrance, silhouetted opening
prose: the mouth of a cave, a jagged stone overhang framing bright daylight outside, scree and boulders across the floor, ferns growing at the lip and the dark of the interior falling away behind
note: The hardest one in this set. The model drops the opening and hands you a sealed interior with no way out, or a rock face with a black hole in it and no interior at all. BOTH sides must be in the same list - the bright daylight outside AND the dark falling away behind - with the arch of rock framing them. State which way the camera looks (out through the mouth, or in from outside), because left unsaid it picks the dull one. Stalactites drag it toward a lit tourist show-cave; scree and ferns keep it wild. firelight is the pairing that gives you the warm pool at the mouth against the dark.
